sloka: ततो नारायणो देवो विषुणुः नियुक्तः सुर सत्तमैः ।जानन् अपि सुरान् एवम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-१६-१॥
transliteration: tato nārāyaṇo devo viṣuṇuḥ niyuktaḥ sura sattamaiḥ ।jānan api surān evam ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt ॥1-16-1॥

translations.english: Although Omniscient lord Narayana knew the means to be employed, when he was requested by the best of devatas he spoke to them softly:
